title: Aha-Flow Distillation: Flow Markers Matter in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.07036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We identify the Flow Moment, a reasoning pattern characterized by sustained, process-confirming verbalizations such as I'm doing, in contrast to the revision- and backtracking-oriented Aha Moment. We refer to their corresponding linguistic expressions as Flow Markers and Aha Markers, respectively. Based on this observation, we construct Flow-CoT by rewriting the discourse markers of original reasoning traces while preserving their underlying reasoning content, and use it as auxiliary supervision for on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). We further propose \textbf{Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)}, a dual-mode extension of OPSD that pairs different forms of privileged information with corresponding reasoning instructions. The Aha branch retains concise solution-based supervision, while the Flow branch introduces rewritten Flow-CoT under a direct and confident reasoning instruction. translated_title: Aha-Flow蒸馏：心流标记在LLM推理中至关重要
translated_abstract: 我们识别出一种称为“心流时刻”的推理模式，其特征是持续的、过程确认式的言语化表达（例如“我正在做”），这与以修订和回溯为导向的“阿哈时刻”形成对比。我们将它们对应的语言表达分别称为“心流标记”和“阿哈标记”。基于这一观察，我们通过在保留底层推理内容的同时改写原始推理轨迹中的话语标记，构建了Flow-CoT，并将其用作在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）的辅助监督。我们进一步提出了Aha-Flow蒸馏（AFD），这是OPSD的一种双模式扩展，将不同形式的特权信息与相应的推理指令配对：阿哈分支保留简洁的基于解决方案的监督，而心流分支则在直接且自信的推理指令下引入改写后的Flow-CoT。在推理阶段，模型仅使用标准的反思性（摘要内容在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文发现了一种与顿悟时刻互补的“心流时刻”推理模式，并提出Aha-Flow蒸馏方法，通过双模式在线自蒸馏将心流标记作为辅助监督，从而提升大语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "Flow Moment," a reasoning pattern complementary to the Aha Moment, and proposes Aha-Flow Distillation, a dual-mode on-policy self-distillation approach that uses rewritten Flow-CoT as auxiliary supervision to enhance LLM reasoning.
